business_summary: Henan Lantian Gas Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in transmission and sale of natural gas in China. It operates through the Natural Gas Business, Engineering Installation Business, and Others segments. The company is involved in midstream long-distance natural gas pipelines; downstream city gas business; gas engineering installation and maintenance; sale and maintenance of gas appliances and accessories; general contracting of municipal public works construction; urban gas supply and storage; heat production and supply; sale of electric vehicle charging stations; and oil and gas pipeline storage and transportation. It also engages in road freight transportation; technology import and export; hazardous chemicals operation; online cultural operation; software development; network and information security software development; artificial intelligence application software development; and construction and installation of gas-related facilities. In addition, the company offers gas business consulting and services, internet information services, value-added telecommunications services, and advertising; and machinery and equipment, industrial automatic control system devices. Henan Lantian Gas Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Zhumadian, China.
